Krueger_ESG.scope: Mandatory disclosure encompasses all E,S,G for the relevant covered population. With gradual topics use the last topic date.
Krueger_ESG.comply_or_explain: Mandatory response, not voluntary. Separate compliance design from mandatory status.
Krueger_ESG.India: 2012 top100 mandate distinct from authors2015 top500 treatment.
Krueger_ESG.voluntary_firm_disclosure: Authors use I/B/E/S managerial earnings guidance, not voluntary ESG adoption. No Guidance is not proxied by liquidity or ESG-score availability.
Krueger_ESG.reference_sample: 35mandate countries and30never-coded countries in2002-2020; separate from39author-workbook publication-year proxies.
Krueger_ESG.unknowns: Individual E,S,G legal dates are not invented from the author workbook, which reports Publication_year and implementation flags.

climate: Climate-only content, including climate-first/local S2 regimes, is not full mandatory E,S,G. Climate governance is not a separate general G mandate. ISSB is a standards family, not a distinct information topic.

CbCR.confidential: BEPS Action13 reports to tax administrations, exchanged under confidentiality and appropriate-use safeguards. Group/entity thresholds and filing roles apply.
CbCR.public_general_MNE: Public income-tax information reporting, e.g. EU2021/2101 and Australia. Public access, geography, timing and thresholds differ from Action13.
CbCR.public_banking: Article89 banking regime, phased public information2014/2015; home-geography comparison distinct from eligible-issuer effects.
CbCR.extractive_payments: Government/project payments in extractive/primary-forest sectors, not general MNE income-tax CbCR.
